info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fitness Memberships Guestpass-v3-spec
info.description: The Fitness Memberships Guestpass Listing API allows clients to retrieve a comprehensive list of available guest passes for fitness memberships. This API serves as a valuable resource for gyms and fitness centers to inform potential customers about their guest pass offerings, including details such as availability and pricing. Typical consumers include gym administrators, sales teams, and marketing professionals who are looking to maximize user engagement through attractive membership options. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their customer outreach by making informed guest pass promotions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access detailed information about the guest pass associated with memberships, including its usage status and expiration date.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve guest pass information for memberships. It should contain the necessary parameters to identify the guest pass, conforming to the defined schema.

ListFitnessMembershipsGuestpassRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on guest passes in the memberships API. It is expected to contain a string value.

ListFitnessMembershipsGuestpassResponse_.title: Guest Pass Response

status.description: Indicates the success or failure of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the guest pass.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the guest pass.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the operation.

ListFitnessMembershipsGuestpassResponse_.description: Response schema for the operations to get guest pass memberships.
